gaps: Chinese and Japanese professional sources have not yet been scanned.

Flash-duration freezing now has two independent full practitioner articles; seek a camera/flash manufacturer manual or independent measurement source for power-versus-duration specifications before extending the advice across equipment.

Skin-tone lighting articles offer individual approaches with different numeric guidance; no universal exposure offset for a skin-tone category is established, and field/backlit conditions need further coverage.

Practical constraints for cosplay/convention locations (crowd movement, flash restrictions, reflective costumes, rapidly changing light) need targeted source discovery; do not infer them from wedding or studio examples.
Mixed LED, fluorescent, and daylight color-matching methods remain incompletely covered; the LED source discusses spectral quality and flicker but not a complete portrait flash-matching workflow.
HSS and normal sync are represented, but cross-camera compatibility, rolling/electronic shutter, and action capture under stage or convention lighting need further coverage.
